nodes.name: adv_above_store_average
nodes.label: Orders where the amount exceeds the store's average order total, identified using a correlated subquery in the WHERE clause.

nodes.name: adv_calendar_with_events
nodes.label: Annotated business calendar joining util_date_spine with campaign dates and supplier contract dates via UNION ALL. Every calendar day shows active business events and their categories.

nodes.name: adv_category_hierarchy
nodes.label: Full parent-child category hierarchy built using a recursive CTE over dim_menu_categories.

nodes.name: adv_conditional_aggregates
nodes.label: Conditional aggregations using PostgreSQL's FILTER clause as a cleaner alternative to CASE WHEN inside aggregate functions.

nodes.name: adv_consecutive_growth
nodes.label: Longest streaks of consecutive month-over-month revenue growth per store, detected using the islands-and-gaps technique with window functions.

nodes.name: adv_cumulative_with_reset
nodes.label: Cumulative daily revenue that resets at the start of each fiscal quarter. Uses util_fiscal_periods for quarter boundaries and partitions the window by fiscal_year and fiscal_quarter.

nodes.name: adv_customer_analysis_cube
nodes.label: All possible aggregation combinations of customer type, location, and order year using CUBE, producing 2^3 = 8 grouping levels including grand total.

nodes.name: adv_customer_health_matrix
nodes.label: 27-segment customer health matrix crossing frequency (high/medium/low), recency (active/cooling/dormant), and monetary (high/medium/low) dimensions using complex nested CASE expressions over int_customer_rfm_scores.

nodes.name: adv_customer_order_pairs
nodes.label: Each customer order paired with their previous order using LAG window function. Outputs days between orders, amount change percentage, whether the store changed, and whether the product mix changed.

nodes.name: adv_customer_product_array
nodes.label: Each customer's purchase history aggregated into a PostgreSQL array using array_agg with DISTINCT and ORDER BY.

nodes.name: adv_customers_never_used_coupon
nodes.label: Customers who have never redeemed a coupon, identified using the NOT EXISTS anti-join pattern against fct_coupon_redemptions. Includes a coupon opportunity segment for targeted marketing.

nodes.name: adv_dynamic_pricing_recommendation
nodes.label: Business rule engine with 10+ pricing rules implemented as layered CASE expressions. Evaluates margin tier and sales velocity to recommend pricing actions such as discounts, increases, or discontinuation.

nodes.name: adv_excluding_current_avg
nodes.label: Per store-day average revenue of the 6 preceding days excluding the current day, using the window frame `rows between 6 preceding and 1 preceding`. Compares today's revenue against this peer average to flag anomalies.

nodes.name: adv_expense_rollup
nodes.label: Hierarchical expense subtotals using ROLLUP on location, category, and month, producing subtotals at each level of the hierarchy.

nodes.name: adv_first_purchase_product
nodes.label: The product from each customer's earliest order, found using a correlated subquery that matches on customer_id and minimum order date.

nodes.name: adv_gap_analysis
nodes.label: Days where a store had no orders, detected by cross joining the date spine with locations and identifying gaps in the time series.

nodes.name: adv_latest_event_per_customer
nodes.label: Each customer's last 5 orders with full details, retrieved efficiently using a LATERAL join.

nodes.name: adv_latest_price_per_product
nodes.label: Most recent price for each product using PostgreSQL's DISTINCT ON, a concise alternative to ROW_NUMBER() plus filter.

nodes.name: adv_latest_review_per_product
nodes.label: Most recent review for each product using PostgreSQL's DISTINCT ON.

nodes.name: adv_missing_data_detector
nodes.label: Store-date combinations with no orders, found by cross joining util_date_spine with stg_locations and left joining against stg_orders. Flags missing data with severity levels for data quality monitoring.

nodes.name: adv_moving_median
nodes.label: 7-day moving median revenue per store, computed via a LATERAL subquery with percentile_cont since standard window functions do not support median.

nodes.name: adv_multi_filter_summary

nodes.name: change-declares-blast-radius
nodes.label: A model or column change must report what it breaks before it lands, including the human who owns each affected exposure.

props.intent: A model or column change must report what it breaks before it lands, including the human who owns each affected exposure.

nodes.name: change-verified-against-baseline
nodes.label: A blast radius is a prediction made from lineage. Lineage cannot say whether the numbers actually moved, so a change to a mart must also be compared against a b

props.intent: A blast radius is a prediction made from lineage. Lineage cannot say whether the numbers actually moved, so a change to a mart must also be compared against a built baseline before it lands — otherwise "safe" means "nothing downstream references it", not "nothing downstream changed".

nodes.name: entity-requires-identity
nodes.label: A class with no identity property cannot participate in a derived join, so every BI and MDL projection of it is a guess.

props.intent: A class with no identity property cannot participate in a derived join, so every BI and MDL projection of it is a guess.

nodes.name: link-must-be-in-topology
nodes.label: A foreign key pointing at a class the topology does not relate to is an undeclared join. Undeclared joins are how two teams compute different revenue from the s

props.intent: A foreign key pointing at a class the topology does not relate to is an undeclared join. Undeclared joins are how two teams compute different revenue from the same warehouse.

nodes.name: mart-declares-grain
nodes.label: Grain is the one fact a downstream consumer cannot infer and cannot survive guessing. An undeclared grain is how a join silently fans out.

props.intent: Grain is the one fact a downstream consumer cannot infer and cannot survive guessing. An undeclared grain is how a join silently fans out.

nodes.name: metric-owns-aggregation
nodes.label: Aggregation policy — which statuses count, which timestamp, which filter — belongs to exactly one metric definition. A mart column named `revenue` is a second d

props.intent: Aggregation policy — which statuses count, which timestamp, which filter — belongs to exactly one metric definition. A mart column named `revenue` is a second definition that will drift from the first.

nodes.name: money-requires-currency
nodes.label: A monetary amount without its currency is not a number, it is a bug waiting for a second entity to be onboarded.

props.intent: A monetary amount without its currency is not a number, it is a bug waiting for a second entity to be onboarded.

nodes.name: pii-not-in-consumption
nodes.label: PII may land in raw and staging. It must not reach a mart or an exposure without a masking policy or an explicit, recorded waiver.

props.intent: PII may land in raw and staging. It must not reach a mart or an exposure without a masking policy or an explicit, recorded waiver.

nodes.name: review-artifacts-exclude-pii
nodes.label: A value-level diff writes the rows it compared into the review tool's state file, which is durable and shared. Diffing a column whose role is PII therefore pers

props.intent: A value-level diff writes the rows it compared into the review tool's state file, which is durable and shared. Diffing a column whose role is PII therefore persists real addresses into an artefact that gets committed and passed around — the same failure `pii-not-in-consumption` prevents in the warehouse, one layer further out.

nodes.name: secrets-never-in-context
nodes.label: A credential placed in a prompt, a model file or a committed artefact is durably persisted and replayed into every later session.

props.intent: A credential placed in a prompt, a model file or a committed artefact is durably persisted and replayed into every later session.
